title: Why millions of animals rule this plains
description: Discover the secret force that turns a simple grassland into the most crowded place on Earth. It is not just the rain but a hidden cycle that feeds them all.
instagram_caption: What keeps the Serengeti thriving with millions of animals? Follow Wonders of the Nature for more.

segments.narration: The Serengeti looks like endless grass, but a hidden engine powers this place.
broll_queries: grass swaying in wind close up

segments.narration: Millions of animals graze here every year without eating the land to death.
They need constant movement to find the greenest patches of grass for food.
Rain follows the sun, forcing these massive herds to travel in big circles.
broll_queries: wide shot of dark rain clouds

segments.narration: This cycle brings nutrients back into the soil as the massive herds migrate.
Their waste naturally fertilizes the ground, helping the grass grow back even stronger.
broll_queries: zebra teeth eating grass close up

segments.narration: Fire also plays a role, clearing old dead stalks to reveal fresh growth.
Predators follow the herds, keeping the ecosystem balanced and healthy for everyone involved.
Life and death work together to turn simple grass into the planet's buffet.
